ROOT component kit

Theme v1 tokens, components and every shared header and footer state. Import this page first and turn its parts into Figma components and styles; the 75 page files use exactly these classes.

ROOT theme kit

The parts list behind the homepage above. Every page in the 73-page sitemap is built from these tokens, components and templates. Nothing new gets invented page by page.

Taken from Motilal Oswal: one ink colour for all text, a serif for headings only, one shadow for every card, proof before the form, a closing CTA on every block, a menu-free layout for paid landing pages, a sticky form on product pages.

Made ROOT's own: aubergine instead of indigo, gold as the logo's spark, left-aligned headings on the gold root line, Indian multi-script faces, no invented numbers.

ColourTypeSpace, radius, depthButtonsFormsFeedbackNavigationDataIconsMotionLogo and imageryTokens

Colour: one ink, one spark

Every colour comes from the ROOT logo files. Aubergine does the work. Gold is a spark, never a surface.

Aubergine--aub #1C0F2FHeadings, buttons, icons, footer. 18.1:1 on white.
Aubergine 80--aub-80 #3A2E4BBody copy. 12.6:1 on white.
Aubergine 60--aub-60 #5F5571Secondary copy and captions. 6.9:1 on white.
Deep teal--teal #0C2229Only inside the brand gradient.
Gold--gold #C19C2FMark, root line, nodes, one icon detail. Never text or buttons.
Gold wash--gold-wash #F8F2E2"Coming soon" badge and highlights. Text on it uses #7A5A0E.
Mist--mist #F3F5F8Alternating section bands, icon tiles, inputs on white.
Line--line #E2E8EFHairlines and table rules. Logo light grey.
Line 2--line-2 #D1D6DDControl borders. Logo mid grey.
Gain--gain #0B7A55Positive change only. Never decoration.
Loss--loss #B4352BNegative change and errors only.
Brand gradient--grad #1C0F2F → #0C2229From the app icon. One dark band per page, plus article thumbnails. The footer stays light.
Do: gold as a spark
Open free accountSoon

Buttons stay aubergine. Gold marks small things: a badge, a node, one detail in an icon.

Don't: gold as a surface
Open free accountGold headline text

Gold on white is 2.6:1, so gold buttons and gold text fail contrast. They also conflict with the Aikyam Group gold rule. The intern's homepage used both.

Type: a calm serif over a clear sans

Tiro Devanagari Hindi for headings, Mukta for everything else. Both are Indian multi-script families, so Hindi pages later will match the English ones. Figures are tabular wherever numbers line up.

SmallMukta 400 · 15/22You will continue to our secure KYC partner to verify your PAN and Aadhaar.

Hindi checkSame two familiesएक खाते से ट्रेड और निवेश।
खाता खोलना मुफ़्त है। ब्रोकरेज और अन्य शुल्क प्राइसिंग पेज पर दिए गए हैं।
  • Headings are left-aligned and sit on the root line. Write Title case by hand only for product names; everything else is sentence case.
  • Italic serif is allowed once per hero for the second half of the headline. Never bold the serif.
  • No eyebrow labels above headings. The heading carries the section.

Space, radius and depth

An 8px base. A 1200px column. One soft shadow for resting cards, a deeper one for hover and pop-overs. Cards never get a border and a shadow together.

Spacing scale
4
8
12
16
24
32
48
64–112

Section padding is 64px on phones, 112px on desktop. Card padding 24px. Grid gap 20px.

Radius
16 · cards
12 · tiles
10 · controls
pill · chips

Nested radius = outer radius minus the padding between them. Pills are only for small chips and badges.

Depth
shadow-1 · rest
shadow-2 · hover
pop · menus, dialogs

All shadows are tinted aubergine, never grey or black. Hover lifts a card 2px and swaps shadow-1 for shadow-2.

One primary action per view, always aubergine. Labels say exactly what happens. Press scales to 0.96.

Icons: line in aubergine, one gold spark

Drawn on a 24px grid with a 1.5px round stroke. Each product icon carries exactly one small gold detail, the same rule Motilal Oswal uses for its duotone set. UI icons (arrows, chevrons, close) carry none.

Motion: calm, short, never decorative

Weighted for polish over play. Things people do often get instant feedback; rare moments get a gentle entrance. Everything stops for reduced-motion users.

MomentDurationEasingWhat moves
Hero entrance, once per page450ms, 90ms staggercubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)opacity, 8px rise, 4px blur to sharp
Root line grows with scrollscroll-linkedlinear to scrollscaleY of a 1px line; nodes fill gold in 200ms
Card hover200mscubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)2px lift, shadow-1 to shadow-2, arrow nudges
Button press150mscubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)scale 0.96, colour
Mega-menu open / close180ms / 120mscubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)opacity, 4px drop, scale .98 from top-left
Tab indicator250mscubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)translateX and width of one pill
Dialog220mscubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)opacity, 6px rise, scale .98
Calculator numbersinstantnonenothing: values update as the slider moves
Market ticker70s looplinearpauses on hover and focus; off for reduced motion

Not allowed: pulsing CTAs, counting-up numbers, parallax, scroll-jacking, confetti, bouncing springs.

Logo and imagery

The logo files are used exactly as supplied. Imagery is product screens, real people and the logo's own geometry. No stock photos of traders at monitors.

Full lockup. Footer, documents, app store. Min width 120px so "BY AIKYAM" stays legible.

Wordmark. Header (104px wide) and anywhere under 120px.

On dark. The dark band and dark thumbnails only.

App icon. Favicon, app stores, the app band. Mark alone never replaces the wordmark elsewhere.

Thumbnail system
Your title in the serif

Brand gradient, teal gradient or Mist. Two rings from the logo's O-o, the small one in gold. Title in Tiro, max 4 lines. Works for blogs, guides, social posts and ads.

Product screens

Light app screens in a dark phone frame. Every screen carries an "Illustrative" caption with a gold dot. Use example names (Example Bank Ltd), never real tickers with invented prices.

Photography

Real Aikyam people for Leadership, Careers and About: natural light, the Mumbai office, no forced smiles at screens. Customers only with written consent. Until shoots happen, use screens and geometry, not stock.

Tokens

Paste these into the Next.js theme. Components reference these names only, never raw hex values.

CSS custom properties · ROOT theme v1
:root {
  /* colour */
  --aub: #1C0F2F;      --aub-80: #3A2E4B;   --aub-60: #5F5571;
  --teal: #0C2229;     --gold: #C19C2F;     --gold-deep: #A38125;   --gold-wash: #F8F2E2;
  --paper: #FFFFFF;    --mist: #F3F5F8;     --mist-2: #E9EDF2;
  --line: #E2E8EF;     --line-2: #D1D6DD;
  --gain: #0B7A55;     --gain-bg: #E6F4EE;  --loss: #B4352B;        --loss-bg: #FBEDEB;
  --warn: #7A5A0E;     --warn-bg: #FBF4E2;  --info-bg: #EEF0F6;
  --grad: linear-gradient(100deg, #1C0F2F 0%, #170C27 48%, #0C2229 100%);

  /* type: Tiro Devanagari Hindi 400 + italic, Mukta 400/500/600/700, Red Hat Mono 500 */
  --serif: "Tiro Devanagari Hindi", Georgia, serif;
  --sans: "Mukta", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: "Red Hat Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  --fs-d1: clamp(2.45rem, 1.35rem + 3.4vw, 4rem);   /* lh 1.04 */
  --fs-d2: clamp(1.9rem, 1.35rem + 1.7vw, 2.65rem); /* lh 1.12 */
  --fs-d3: clamp(1.45rem, 1.2rem + .7vw, 1.75rem);  /* lh 1.2 */
  --fs-h3: 1.2rem; --fs-lead: 1.2rem; --fs-body: 1.0625rem; --fs-sm: .9375rem; --fs-xs: .8125rem;

  /* shape and depth */
  --r-card: 16px; --r-tile: 12px; --r-ctl: 10px; --r-pill: 999px;
  --shadow-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,15,47,.05), 0 8px 24px -6px rgba(28,15,47,.10);
  --shadow-2: 0 2px 4px rgba(28,15,47,.06), 0 20px 44px -10px rgba(28,15,47,.20);
  --shadow-pop: 0 2px 6px rgba(28,15,47,.08), 0 24px 56px -12px rgba(28,15,47,.28);

  /* layout */
  --wrap: min(1200px, 100% - 2 * clamp(20px, 5vw, 64px));
  --section-y: clamp(64px, 8.5vw, 112px);
  --header-h: 72px;
  /* breakpoints: 640 / 900 / 1100 */

  /* motion */
  --ease-state: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
  --ease-enter: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --t-fast: 150ms; --t-base: 200ms; --t-enter: 450ms;
}

Attention investor

  • Prevent unauthorised transactions in your account. Update your mobile numbers/email IDs with your stock brokers. Receive information of your transactions directly from Exchange on your mobile/email at the end of the day.
  • KYC is one time exercise while dealing in securities markets. Once KYC is done through a SEBI registered intermediary (Broker, DP, Mutual Fund etc.), you need not undergo the same process again when you approach another intermediary.
  • No need to issue cheques by investors while subscribing to IPO. Just write the bank account number and sign in the application form to authorize your bank to make payment in case of allotment.

Disclaimer

  • This website is owned and maintained by Aikyam and the content contained on this website is provided for general information only and should not be used as a basis for making business/commercial decisions.
  • The Content on this website should not be regarded as an offer, solicitation, invitation, advice or recommendation to buy or sell investments, securities or any other instrument or financial products / schemes of Aikyam, or any of its subsidiaries/affiliates.
  • "Investment in securities market are subject to market risks, read all the related documents carefully before investing."

Caution notice for public

  • Aikyam Capital cautions the public against unknown or fraudulent persons falsely claiming to be associated with Aikyam Capital Private Limited through WhatsApp groups, social media channels, websites or other platforms.
  • All receipts of funds are made only in the name of Aikyam Capital Private Limited in designated bank accounts.
